name: Undead Scourge
summary: A relentless destroyer of undead whose smite, life-giving aura, and annihilating strike are specialized against the unliving.

featureOverrides.summary: Smite Evil deals double Paladin-level damage on every smite attack against evil undead, but not on the first attack against evil dragons or outsiders.

features.name: Aura of Life
features.summary: Undead within 10 feet take –4 on Will saves against positive energy and cannot heal from channeled negative energy.

features.name: Undead Annihilation
features.summary: Spend one smite use to make a melee attack that destroys an undead target on a failed Will save unless it has at least twice your Hit Dice.
